svg.title: Reading the Dühring chart (Foust Fig. 19.11): both effects
svg.text: Reading the Dühring chart (Foust Fig. 19.11): both effects
NaOH–H₂O Dühring lines (straight lines), redrawn; right: zoom of the reading area
Effect I: its vapour space is at 175.7 °F (boiling point of water): mark it on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the 50 % NaOH line (highlighted).
Go across to the left axis. 4 Read T₁ ≈ 251.1 °F (BPE = 75.4 °F).
Effect II: water boils at 101.0 °F (2 in Hg abs): mark it on the bottom axis.
Go up to an 8.9 % line, interpolated between the 0 % and 10 % lines (dashed).
Go across to the left axis. 8 Read T₂ ≈ 105.7 °F (BPE = 4.7 °F).
Hollow circle: where this redraw puts the point when it differs visibly from the solution’s reading.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
